title: Halftime Hero
overview: In 1994 London, just as big-hearted, big-mouthed football supporter, Steve 'Pringle' Davies hits rock bottom, he gets pulled from the crowd by coach Harry Redknapp at halftime to play a professional game for his beloved West Ham United. It’s a million-to-one shot that just might save his relationship with his first love, Penny, and get this glory-hunter’s life back on track.
